subject: prd/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: When a ready draft is prepared, the system shall preserve valid Argus content-bound trailers across rebase, compile the contract against current mainline, publish the exact prepared head with a lease, update the same selected-host PR, and request separate human review of that head; before permitting a prepared contract to merge, enforce the configured human's authenticated approval of the exact current head, dismissal after a new push, and the same rule for privileged actors, or refuse with a named protection remedy.
fit_criterion: Source/rebased bindings validate; digest equals stored texts; PR head equals prepared SHA; reviewer differs from agent; unapproved, stale, agent-approved, or privileged-bypass merge attempts are refused before compiled records reach mainline; fresh configured-human approval of the exact head permits merge; post-merge review and mainline checks still apply.
